name: 薄皮爆浆羊角蜜瓜鲜果款
description: 薄皮一咬就破，脆爽多汁的当季羊角蜜瓜鲜果

styleLock.direction: deep-green fresh melon detail-page commerce with white stroked cards, scalloped bands and stitched badges
styleLock.backgroundSystem: muted sage-green #6DAB6C page fields carrying large pure white #FFFFFF rounded cards with a 4px deep vine green #3F7D3E stroke; scalloped deep-green band edges between sections; wood and rustic surfaces only inside the scene shot
styleLock.lightingSystem: bright even soft studio light from the front-top with gentle fill, 5500K, soft contact shadows, glistening freshly cut surfaces, no harsh speculars, never plastic
styleLock.surfaceSystem: matte pale board #F2F4EC for macro shots, warm wood #A9743F round tray and a rustic dark-bronze ridged plate for the scene shot
styleLock.typography: modern bold rounded geometric sans-serif headline type, single deep vine green #3F7D3E
styleLock.iconSystem: thin-line monochrome icons in deep vine green #3F7D3E; stitched dashed-ring circle badges, slashed-circle exclusion icons and small square numbered tags
styleLock.presentationRules: stable product scale; the cut face and amber seed cavity always face the camera; white cards keep a consistent rounded corner radius and green stroke
styleLock.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent deep-green fresh melon detail-page visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of clean white #FFFFFF card fields, muted sage-green #6DAB6C page fields, deep vine green #3F7D3E for bands, strokes and text, and one amber seed-cavity accent #DFA033; neutral fresh tone with a cool green cast; muted sage-green #6DAB6C page fields carrying large pure white #FFFFFF rounded cards with a 4px deep vine green #3F7D3E stroke and soft corner rounding, separated by scalloped green band edges; bright even soft studio light from the front-top with gentle fill, 5500K, soft contact shadows, glistening freshly cut surfaces, never plastic; matte pale board #F2F4EC surfaces for macro shots and a warm wood #A9743F round tray for the scene shot; modern bold rounded geometric sans-serif headline type only in deep vine green #3F7D3E; consistent stitched dashed-ring circle badges, slashed-circle exclusion icons and small square numbered tags; stable product scale with the cut face and amber seed cavity always facing the camera; every screen composed as one complete balanced layout with natural breathing margins; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles.

shots.intent: 开场一秒传达薄皮爆浆多汁的核心卖点，绿底白字先声夺人
shots.camera: 眼平略低，轻微 3/4 视角；三只对切与两只整瓜置于圆木托盘，托盘组落在画面下二分之一
shots.lighting: 顶正面柔和棚拍光加补光，5500K，托盘下软接触阴影，切面湿润带反光
shots.background: 实心苔绿场 #6DAB6C，底部圆木托盘 #A9743F 托面
shots.props: 圆木托盘、薄荷叶与大片绿叶点缀，上部两角可有极淡的绿色瓜形虚影
shots.textZone: 画面上部大号主标题 「{callout_1}」 于 #FFFFFF，旁侧一枚竖排小字标 「{selling_point_1}」 于 #FFFFFF
shots.promptTemplate: E-commerce opening poster hero of {product}. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Photographed at a slight 3/4 angle just below eye level: three halved elongated melons and two whole ones arranged on a round warm wood #A9743F tray in the lower half of the frame, cut faces and amber seed cavities #DFA033 facing the camera, fresh mint sprigs and one broad green leaf as garnish, a very faint blurred green melon hint in the upper corners. Bright even soft studio light from the front-top with gentle fill, 5500K, soft contact shadow under the tray, glistening juicy cut surfaces, natural fruit texture, never plastic. The melon cluster occupies 50-60% of the frame; the upper area carries a large headline 「{callout_1}」 in #FFFFFF with one small vertical side label 「{selling_point_1}」 beside it, so the poster reads as one finished composition. 8K, commercial fresh-produce e-commerce quality. Negative: no brand logo, no fake seal, no watermark, no QR code, no extra text beyond the quoted slots, no plastic-looking fruit, no floating fruit without contact shadow, no cut-off tray edges, no duplicated fruit.

shots.intent: 用一组细线图标把新鲜、脆爽、多汁三大利益一眼说清
shots.camera: 正面平视，镜头与白卡平面完全垂直
shots.lighting: 均匀扁平棚拍光，无戏剧性阴影
shots.background: 实心苔绿场 #6DAB6C 上一张大号圆角白卡 #FFFFFF，卡缘 4px 瓜藤深绿 #3F7D3E 描边
shots.props: 三枚细线图标（叶片、太阳、水滴）与细竖线分隔，两只整瓜自卡底部探入
shots.textZone: 卡内上方主标题 「{callout_1}」；图标行下方三行短标 「{selling_point_1}」「{selling_point_2}」「{selling_point_3}」，均 #3F7D3E
shots.promptTemplate: E-commerce benefit hero of {product}. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. A large pure white #FFFFFF rounded card with a 4px deep vine green #3F7D3E stroke centered on a solid muted sage-green #6DAB6C page field, the camera perfectly perpendicular to the card plane. Inside the card: a bold headline 「{callout_1}」 in #3F7D3E, below it a row of three thin-line monochrome icons — a leaf, a sun and a water drop — separated by thin vertical dividers, each icon above one short label 「{selling_point_1}」, 「{selling_point_2}」 and 「{selling_point_3}」 in #3F7D3E; two whole elongated melons with pale green mottled rind enter from the bottom edge of the card, the melons filling 50-60% of the frame so headline, icons and fruit read as one balanced card. Negative: no brand logo, no watermark, no fabricated nutrition or certification claims, no dense body text, no extra text beyond the quoted slots, no props beyond the two melons, no cut-off card edges, no plastic-looking fruit.

shots.intent: 放大普通蜜瓜皮厚难嚼的痛点，反衬薄皮一咬就破
shots.camera: 双格分屏，两格机位、景别与构图完全一致，均为 45° 高角度俯拍
shots.lighting: 两格光位一致；左格平光偏闷，右格同光位下更清爽透亮
shots.background: 哑光灰绿台面 #C9CCC6，两格同底色
shots.props: 左格一只普通厚皮瓜作示意；右格对切的 {product}
shots.textZone: 每格一枚短标签 「{callout_1}」「{callout_2}」 于 #3F7D3E，外加一枚瓜藤深绿 #3F7D3E 圆徽章（白色虚线描边环）
shots.promptTemplate: E-commerce pain-point split screen, two matched panels with identical framing, identical crop and identical lighting, both photographed from a high 45-degree angle looking down. Left panel: one generic ordinary thick-rind melon, small and coarse-textured, on a dull desaturated grey-green counter #C9CCC6 under flat tired light, communicating a thick chewy rind. Right panel: {product} on the same counter #C9CCC6 under the same light position but fresh, with a thin rind and pale yellow-green flesh #D9DE8E, communicating an easy bite and crisp juicy texture. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Each subject fills 50-60% of its panel, and each panel carries one short label 「{callout_1}」 and 「{callout_2}」 in #3F7D3E plus one deep vine green #3F7D3E circular badge with a stitched dashed white ring, the two panels meeting at a clean center seam so the split reads balanced. Negative: no fabricated statistics, ratings or test data, no competitor brand marks, no brand logo, no watermark, no extra text beyond the quoted slots, no deformed fruit, no plastic look.

shots.intent: 低角度实景让用户代入真实食用场景，粗陶与木桌强化新鲜产地感
shots.camera: 贴近桌面低机位微微仰视，视线横跨粗陶盘边缘，整瓜立于后景
shots.lighting: 左上方方向性日光，5500K，软接触阴影，切面湿润反光
shots.background: 暖木桌面 #A9743F 与深青铜色棱纹粗陶盘，背景柔和虚化
shots.props: 薄荷与细香草枝条、两只瓜藤深绿 #3F7D3E 编号小方牌（白圈数字）
shots.textZone: 画面边缘两只编号方牌各一行短标 「{callout_1}」「{callout_2}」 于 #FFFFFF
shots.promptTemplate: Lifestyle scene: {product} on a rustic dark-bronze ridged plate on a warm wood #A9743F table, several cross-section slices fanned out with pale yellow-green flesh #D9DE8E and amber seed cavities #DFA033 facing the camera, one whole mottled melon resting behind, mint and small green herb sprigs as garnish. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Photographed from a near-table-level low angle looking slightly up across the plate rim, the fruit filling 40-50% of the frame. Soft directional daylight from the upper left, 5500K, soft contact shadows, glistening juicy cut surfaces. Two small deep vine green #3F7D3E square tags with a white circle number sit at the frame edges, each carrying one short label 「{callout_1}」 and 「{callout_2}」 in #FFFFFF, the softly blurred background giving the scene natural depth so it reads as one candid moment. Negative: no hands, no visible face, no brand logo, no watermark, no extra text beyond the quoted slots, no cutlery clutter, no floating fruit, no plastic look.

shots.intent: 断面微距直接证明瓜肉水润、籽腔金黄爆浆
shots.camera: 90° 正上方俯拍微距，浅景深，前景断面清晰
shots.lighting: 左上方斜射光，突出多汁质感与籽粒反光，无硬高光
shots.whitespace: clean natural margin around the cut face
shots.promptTemplate: Extreme close-up macro of the cut cross-section of {product}. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Photographed straight down from a 90-degree overhead angle, tight zoom on the cut face: a thin rind line, pale yellow-green flesh #D9DE8E and a glistening amber seed cavity #DFA033 with fresh seeds, shallow depth of field with the foreground crisp. Raking top light from the upper left reveals the juicy surface texture. Matte pale board background #F2F4EC. The cut face fills 55-60% of the frame and a clean natural margin surrounds it, because the detail is the whole point. Negative: no blurry subject, no extra text, no watermark, no brand logo, no props, no dried or browned flesh, no plastic sheen, no duplicated seeds.

shots.intent: 果皮斑纹微距证明自然生长质感，打消打蜡与人工处理的疑虑
shots.camera: 90° 正侧面贴皮微距，沿瓜体长度方向取景，浅景深近棱清晰
shots.lighting: 右侧斜射光，凸显斑纹与细颗粒质感
shots.whitespace: clean top margin, the texture is the whole point
shots.promptTemplate: Extreme close-up macro of the rind of {product}. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Photographed from a clean 90-degree side profile along the melon's length, tight zoom on the skin: a pale green #C9E29B base with darker deep vine green #3F7D3E mottled streaks and fine natural speckle texture, shallow depth of field with the near ridge crisp. Raking side light from the right reveals the surface. Matte pale board background #F2F4EC. The rind detail fills 55-60% of the frame and the top of the frame stays a clean margin, because the texture is the whole point. Negative: no blurry subject, no wax-coated plastic look, no extra text, no watermark, no brand logo, no sticker or label on the skin, no props, no duplicated texture.

shots.background: 实心苔绿场 #6DAB6C 上一张圆角白卡 #FFFFFF，瓜藤深绿 #3F7D3E 描边

shots.textZone: 主标题 「{callout_1}」、胶囊小标 「{callout_2}」、四行表头 「{callout_3}」至「{callout_6}」与对应取值栏，均 #3F7D3E

shots.intent: 给出三种吃法让用户对号入座，扩大使用场景

shots.lighting: 均匀扁平棚拍光，三格光位与亮度完全一致
shots.background: 白场 #FFFFFF，三格拱顶圆角面板为淡黄绿 #E4EBC0 底、瓜藤深绿 #3F7D3E 细描边
shots.props: 三格内容分别为沙拉碗、生切条与小块果切，同机位同比例
shots.whitespace: about 15% even page margins around the panel row
shots.textZone: 上方胶囊小标 「{callout_1}」 与标题 「{callout_2}」 于 #3F7D3E；每格下方一行短标 「{selling_point_1}」「{selling_point_2}」「{selling_point_3}」 于 #3F7D3E
shots.promptTemplate: E-commerce usage-variant layout for {product}. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Three equal arch-topped rounded panels in one row on a white #FFFFFF field, each panel in a pale melon yellow-green tint #E4EBC0 with a thin deep vine green #3F7D3E stroke, each showing a different way to enjoy the cut {product} — a fruit-salad bowl, raw wedges and small bite-size cubes — with the identical hero angle and identical scale in all three panels. Above the row: a deep vine green pill label 「{callout_1}」 and a bold headline 「{callout_2}」 in #3F7D3E; under each panel one short label 「{selling_point_1}」, 「{selling_point_2}」 and 「{selling_point_3}」 in #3F7D3E. The camera is perfectly perpendicular to the layout, even flat studio light, the three panels together filling 55-65% of the frame with about 15% even page margins around them. Negative: no mixed lighting or mixed angles across panels, no fabricated nutrition claims, no extra text beyond the quoted slots, no watermark, no brand logo, no messy table.

shots.intent: 收口促单，突出当季鲜果与规格，行动按钮把决策收束到下单
shots.camera: 低机位轻微 3/4 视角，瓜体组位于白卡右侧，整瓜与对切各一
shots.lighting: 均匀柔和棚拍光，软接触阴影
shots.background: 实心苔绿场 #6DAB6C 上一张大号圆角白卡 #FFFFFF
shots.props: 一枚瓜藤深绿 #3F7D3E 圆角 CTA 按钮与一枚虚线圆徽章（不写数值），整瓜与对切瓜体各一
shots.textZone: 卡内标题 「{callout_1}」 与短副标 「{callout_2}」 于 #3F7D3E；CTA 按钮上短文案 「{callout_3}」 于 #FFFFFF
shots.promptTemplate: E-commerce closing CTA shot of {product}. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. A muted sage-green #6DAB6C page field with one large pure white #FFFFFF rounded card carrying a bold headline 「{callout_1}」 and one short sub-label 「{callout_2}」 in #3F7D3E; beside the card, a group of whole and halved {product} melons with the amber seed cavity #DFA033 facing the camera fills 60-70% of the frame, shot at a slight 3/4 angle at low eye level. Below the card, one rounded CTA button in deep vine green #3F7D3E with short CTA text 「{callout_3}」 in #FFFFFF and one stitched dashed-ring circular badge without any numbers complete the composition. Bright even soft studio light with soft contact shadows. Negative: no real discount numbers, no invented shipping, service or certification claims, no watermark, no brand logo, no fake countdown, no QR code, no extra text beyond the quoted slots.

provenance.notes: 从 10 屏羊角蜜爆款详情长图切片提炼；已剥离原店二维码/会员入口、山东产地声明、原文案与独特排版，图内中文一律改为 「」+ 占位符；源图规格（10 斤装）与储存温度等数值无独立证据，统一转为 {callout} 文案槽位由使用方填写；营养与承诺类声明不进图，信任表达只保留可验证的切面、果皮与吃法画面。视觉系统以白描边圆角卡 + 扇贝色带 + 虚线圆徽章 + 黄绿瓜肉与琥珀瓤心为特征，按 taxonomy 判定为生鲜粮油/水果，与库内网纹蜜瓜、藤熟小番茄套图区分。
